rapoarte.imagini_indiciu: Add one PNG/JPEG image per area, alongside the text. Maximum 2 MiB and 4 million pixels per image; height 5–35 mm. Images are shared across languages and repeated on every page.
rapoarte.paginare_indiciu: A report can have one or more pages. Content flows automatically; headers, footers, images and page numbering repeat on every page.
rapoarte.imagine_invalida: Invalid image. Choose a complete PNG or JPEG file with a name of at most 200 characters.
rapoarte.imagine_prea_mare: The image exceeds 2 MiB, 4096 px per dimension or 4 million pixels. Choose a smaller image.
rapoarte.inaltime_imagine_invalida: Image height must be between 5 and 35 mm.
ui.definire_rapoarte_descriere: Configure each report's header, content and footer.
ui.rapoarte_descriere: Preview, save the PDF and open it for printing.
rapoarte.tiparire_indiciu: The PDF opens in the associated application. Choose the printer, pages and number of copies using Print (Ctrl+P).
rapoarte.deschis: The PDF is open for viewing and printing.
rapoarte.eroare: The report could not be read, generated or saved. Try again.
rapoarte.nume_invalid: Enter a report name of at most 100 characters.
rapoarte.continut_invalid: Choose a valid data source and distinct columns. Monthly timesheets must include the employee.

rapoarte.text_invalid: Each text may contain at most 1000 characters and 6 explicit lines.
rapoarte.variabila_invalida: The text contains an unknown field or incomplete braces. Use the listed fields.
rapoarte.conflict: The template has changed. Local changes were not saved; keep your text and reload the list.
rapoarte.inexistent: The report template no longer exists. Reload the list.
rapoarte.inactiv: The template is inactive. Select an active template or reactivate it in Report definitions.

rapoarte.alege_angajat: Select a valid employee for the individual timesheet.
rapoarte.prea_mare: The report exceeds 10000 rows. Narrow the selection.
rapoarte.aspect_prea_mare: The content does not fit the selected page. Shorten the text, reduce the font or image height, or select a larger page size.
rapoarte.expirat: The preview is no longer available. Generate the report again.
rapoarte.deschidere_esuata: The PDF is ready but the associated application could not be opened. Use Save PDF and open the file manually.

rapoarte.fara_date: No records for the current selection.
rapoarte.lista_goala: No report templates. Add one in Report definitions.

ui.absente_descriere: Record annual leave, medical leave and special days off for each employee.
absente.tipuri_indiciu: Define special types with their own code and name, then select them when recording days. Deactivation preserves history; the code and category of a used type are protected.
absente.sumar_indiciu: Counts represent days explicitly recorded in the selected year. Contractual entitlement is the current value in the employee record; it is not a calculated balance or historical entitlement. Medical leave and special days are counted separately.
absente.gol: No absence days recorded for the current selection.
absente.confirma_anulare: Cancel the {{numar}} selected days? Change history will be preserved.
absente.selecteaza_toate: Select all days in the list
absente.selectie_indiciu: Select the days to record explicitly. All dates in the range are initially selected, including weekends and holidays. You can clear any day; the selection does not determine pay or statutory leave consumption.
absente.interval_invalid: Choose a valid range of at most 366 days.
absente.selectie_invalida: Select an employee and at least one day.
absente.zi_ocupata: One of the selected days already has an absence. Edit or cancel the existing record.
absente.cod_invalid: Use 1–16 unaccented letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Existing codes cannot be renamed.
absente.cod_duplicat: This code is already used by a shift or an absence type.
absente.categorie_invalida: Choose annual leave, medical leave or special days.
absente.categorie_folosita: A used type cannot change category. Create a new type.
absente.tip_invalid: The absence type does not exist or is inactive. Reload the list and select an active type.
absente.lot_invalid: An absence batch must contain 1–10000 valid days without duplicates.
absente.conflict: These days have changed. Reload the records before reapplying the change; the batch was not saved.
absente.pontaj_existent: One of these days already has a draft or recorded time entry, including a shift spanning that day. Correct the time entry first; no days in the batch were saved.
absente.celula_protejata: This day is recorded in Leave and absences. Edit or cancel the absence there before changing the time entry.
absente.fisier_indiciu: Signed PDF, PNG or JPG (up to 10 MB, stored encrypted in the database).
absente.nr_inregistrare_invalid: The registration number may contain at most 64 valid characters.
absente.inlocuitor_invalid: Choose another active employee as replacement.
absente.aprobat_de_invalid: The 'Approved by' field may contain at most 120 valid characters.
absente.document_invalid: Attach a valid PDF, PNG or JPG file up to 10 MB.
absente.document_inexistent: The attached document is no longer available.
ui.sarbatori_descriere: The annual calendar of public holidays and non-working days.
sarbatori.precizare: Romania 2026: 17 named holidays on 16 distinct dates; 1 June is both Children's Day and Pentecost Monday. Movable dates in this set follow the Orthodox calendar. For other religious calendars, check and adapt the dates before use.
sarbatori.gol: No holidays defined for the selected year.
sarbatori.import_indiciu: Only missing dates from the 2026 national list will be added. Existing records and edited names are preserved.
sarbatori.completate: Added {{numar}} dates. Existing records were preserved.
sarbatori.denumire_obligatorie: Enter a name in at least one language.
sarbatori.inexistenta: This holiday is no longer available. Reload the list.
sarbatori.data_duplicata: A holiday already exists for this date. Edit the existing record.
ui.schimburi_descriere: Configure the codes and intervals used when entering timesheets.
schimburi.indiciu: A code such as N12 is a configurable shortcut. Enter the start time, duration and break explicitly for each shift.
schimburi.gol: No shift types configured yet. Add a code and its interval.
schimburi.cod_invalid: The code must contain 1–16 characters: letters A–Z, digits, hyphens or underscores.
schimburi.cod_duplicat: A shift with this code already exists, including inactive shifts.
schimburi.interval_invalid: Check the start time, duration between 1 and 2880 minutes, and break between 0 and the shift duration.
schimburi.inexistent: The shift is no longer available. Reload the list.
ui.pontaj_descriere: The monthly draft, with quick entry and your team's calendar.

pontaj.schita_indiciu: Timesheet draft: codes and values are stored as text. The template totals remain uncalculated until meanings and rules are confirmed.
pontaj.tastatura: Arrows / Enter / Tab · Shift to select · Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V to copy and paste.
pontaj.necalculat: The rules for this column have not yet been confirmed.
pontaj.fara_angajati: No employees for the current selection. Add employees or change the department.
pontaj.inactivi_indiciu: Inactive employees appear if they have saved drafts this month.
pontaj.lipire_invalida: The data does not fit the grid or a value exceeds 16 characters. No changes from this batch were applied.
pontaj.clipboard: Direct copying is unavailable. Use Ctrl+C in the grid.
pontaj.perioada_invalida: Choose a year between 1 and 9999 and a month between 1 and 12.
pontaj.lot_invalid: The cell batch is too large or contains duplicates.
pontaj.celula_invalida: A cell has a date outside the month, a missing employee or an invalid value.
pontaj.conflict: Another instance changed one of these cells. Your draft has not been overwritten; copy your changes and reload the month before saving again.
ui.departamente_descriere: Each department belongs to a section. Employees can then be assigned to departments within their section.
date.departament_invalid: Choose an active department within the employee's section.
schimburi.completate: Added {{numar}} shifts. Existing configurations were preserved.
schimburi.sursa_initiale: Lab category (prefill): Z7 07–14, S7 15–22, N9 22–07, IN9 22–07, Z12 07–19, N12 19–07 and G24 07–07. All other codes belong to the Custom category; previous settings are preserved, and the initial break is 0 minutes and editable.
schimburi.intrare_indiciu: IN9 is the special 22–07 shift starting on the evening before a weekend or holiday. Record it on its start date, for example Friday for entry into Saturday. The regime distinguishes it without defining premiums or automatic assignments.
